originalTitle: U.S. stock futures rise after AI rout batters Wall St; payrolls data in focus
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures firmed on Thursday evening, heralding some recovery after increasing doubts over the AI trade in a Democrat-led Congress wiped out hundreds of billions from Wall Street.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures firmed on Thursday evening, heralding some recovery after increasing doubts over the AI trade in a Democrat-led Congress wiped out hundreds of billions from Wall Street.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

Focus was now on upcoming labor market data for more cues on the economy and interest rates, with markets also on guard over any more hawkish signals for the Federal Reserve.

S&P 500 Futures rose 0.26% to 7,402.0 points by 19:39 ET (00:39 GMT). Nasdaq 100 Futures rose 0.83% to 26,970.50 points, while Dow Jones Futures fell 0.15% to 51,537.0 points.

Futures remained skittish after Wall Street suffered its worst day in nearly 19 months on Thursday, battered chiefly by a major wipeout in high-flying technology and artificial intelligence stocks.

Chipmakers were by far the worst hit, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index sliding 12.25% for the day. NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA), which recently relinquished its title as the world's most valuable listed company, slumped nearly 10% on Thursday, while rival AMD (NASDAQ:AMD) slid 17%.

Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT), Meta Platforms Inc (NASDAQ:META), Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN), and Alphabet Inc (NASDAQ:GOOGL)– all of which are heavily exposed to data center spending– fell between 2% and 4%, while iPhone maker Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) performed relatively better with a 1.5% drop.

The Democratic Party's sweep of the midterm elections– where it secured majorities in both chambers of Congress– sparked heightened concerns over more regulatory scrutiny towards AI development and data center construction.

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

Texas Governor-Elect, Democrat Gina Hinojosa, called for a pause on any new data center construction until there were laws to protect citizens in place. Her comments reflected a broader rhetoric among Democratic lawmakers, especially amid growing voter pushback against more data center construction across the country.

The development came amid already growing doubts over the long-term feasibility of AI, after a host of middling September quarter earnings from Wall Street's biggest firms pointed to uncertain returns on their massive AI investments.

Separately, reports said AI major Anthropic was facing increased investor scrutiny over its plans to publicly list later this month, with Reuters reporting that the startup could potentially delay a listing.

The NASDAQ Composite slumped 5.5% on Thursday, the S&P 500 fell 4.4%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average shed 3.4%. The Dow took some support from flows into non-tech, defensive sectors like utilities and consumer staples.

Nonfarm payrolls awaited for more rate cues

Beyond the AI rout, focus on Friday will be squarely on key labor data that is likely to factor into the Federal Reserve's plans for interest rates.

Nonfarm payrolls data for September is due Friday morning, and is expected to show a pickup in jobs growth from the prior month.

Any signs of resilience in the labor market give the Fed more headroom to hike interest rates– a scenario that could herald more pain for Wall Street.

The Fed raised rates by 25 basis points in September, with policymakers indicating that sticky inflation was likely to elicit more hikes.

chineseTitle: AI 溃败冲击华尔街后，美国股指期货上涨；就业数据成为焦点
chineseSummary: Investing.com——美国股指期货周四晚间走强，预示着在民主党领导的国会对人工智能交易的疑虑加剧导致华尔街损失了数千亿美元之后，美国股指期货出现了一定程度的复苏。
chineseContent:
Investing.com——美国股指期货周四晚间走强，预示着在民主党领导的国会对人工智能交易的疑虑加剧导致华尔街损失了数千亿美元之后，美国股指期货出现了一定程度的复苏。

还在猜测哪些股票会跑赢大盘？我们的人工智能投资组合每月更新一次，表现优于标准普尔 500 指数 118%。查看本月列表 »

现在的焦点是即将公布的劳动力市场数据，以获取有关经济和利率的更多线索，市场也对美联储发出任何更强硬的信号保持警惕。

截至美国东部时间 19:39（格林威治标准时间 00:39），标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.26% 至 7,402.0 点。纳斯达克100期货上涨0.83%至26,970.50点，道琼斯期货下跌0.15%至51,537.0点。

周四，华尔街经历了近 19 个月来最糟糕的一天，主要受到飞速发展的科技和人工智能股票大幅下跌的打击，之后期货市场仍显得紧张不安。

迄今为止，芯片制造商受到的打击最为严重，费城半导体指数当天下跌 12.25%。 NVIDIA 公司（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）最近放弃了全球最有价值上市公司的称号，该公司周四股价下跌近 10%，而竞争对手 AMD（纳斯达克股票代码：AMD）则下跌 17%。

微软公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）、Meta Platforms Inc（纳斯达克股票代码：META）、亚马逊公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AMZN）和Alphabet公司（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOGL）——所有这些公司都严重依赖数据中心支出——股价下跌了2%至4%，而iPhone制造商苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）的表现相对较好，下跌了1.5%。

民主党在中期选举中大获全胜，在参众两院获得多数席位，引发了人们对人工智能开发和数据中心建设面临更多监管审查的高度担忧。

不确定在盈利之前买什么？在业绩下滑后，我们的 AI 最近的财报前电话会议带来了 +77% 至 +118% 的涨幅。查看本月收益精选 »

德克萨斯州当选州长、民主党人吉娜·伊诺霍萨呼吁暂停任何新数据中心的建设，直到出台保护公民的法律。她的言论反映了民主党议员中更广泛的言论，特别是在选民越来越反对全国范围内建设更多数据中心的情况下。

这一进展发生之际，人们对人工智能的长期可行性已经越来越怀疑，因为华尔街最大的公司在 9 月份季度中期的财报表明，他们大规模的人工智能投资的回报不确定。

另外，有报道称，人工智能巨头 Anthropic 因其本月晚些时候公开上市的计划而面临着越来越严格的投资者审查，路透社报道称，该初创公司可能会推迟上市。

周四，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 5.5%，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 4.4%，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌 3.4%。道琼斯指数因流入公用事业和消费必需品等非科技、防御性行业的资金而获得了一些支撑。

非农就业数据等待更多利率线索

除了人工智能溃败之外，周五的焦点将集中在可能影响美联储利率计划的关键劳动力数据上。

9 月份非农就业数据将于周五上午公布，预计将显示就业增长较上月有所回升。

劳动力市场的任何复苏迹象都会给美联储带来更大的加息空间——这种情况可能预示着华尔街将遭受更多痛苦。

美联储9月份加息25个基点，政策制定者表示粘性通胀可能会引发更多加息。
